item.title: FW3GT – Wallis & Futuna
item.dc:creator: DX-World
item.description:
[NEWS UPDATE] 80m is not going to happen, very low impedance which I matched with hairpin. Problem is it detuned other bands significantly, loosing 20 & 17m. Even with hairpin disconnected 20m was not usable. Cut my losses and removed 60/80 element, now have 30m again. 60m was successful with over 500 QSOs. Likely QRT […]
